text:
Jamie H: Quick question — I need to grant a CI service account read-only access to logs in project `sandbox-analytics` for a one-off debug (30m). Is it OK to grant `roles/logging.viewer` at org level or should I scope it down?

Priya S: definitely scope down. never org-level for CI SAs.

Lukas M: +1. either a project-level binding or a custom role with the minimal logging perms. example minimal perms: `logging.logEntries.list`, `logging.logs.list`, `logging.logMetrics.list` (only what the job needs).

Jamie H: cool — wanted to double-check. Is there a recommended workflow for making it time-limited? IAM conditions, ephemeral creds, or just manual revert?

Priya S: prefer IAM Condition on the binding if your IAM supports it. you can add a condition on `request.time` to expire after X minutes. otherwise create a custom role + project binding and use the JIT access flow for approval. no long-lived keys. :no_entry_sign:

Lukas M: example condition snippet (gcloud):
```
PROJECT=sandbox-analytics
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-bot@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/logging.viewer \
  --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp(\"2025-12-01T15:30:00Z\"),title=expiring-debug,description=one-off-debug"
```
That attaches a time condition to the binding.

Jamie H: nice, that avoids manual revoke. any policy constraints we should hit?

sec-bot: Automated check: org policy disallows org-level logging.viewer grants without Sec approval. Project-level with a condition is allowed. Please open a JIT request at https://redwood.example.com/jit and @Priya S for approval.

Jamie H: filing the JIT request now and tagging Priya. thanks! :thumbsup:

Priya S: once approved i can create the binding (or you can paste the command and i'll run it). leave the expiry at 30m unless you need more.

Jamie H: I'll request 30m and attach the debug run ID. thanks all.
